I'd be OK if you just wanted to remove these comments since we don't install the MRW for systems anymore.

Does it make sense to keep this file if the script and service files it mentions are being deleted? Does ac-server use this?

I don't use this for BMC-based VRM support. So unless it is used by hostboot or something, I don't think this is used on p10bmc. The VRM bus/addrs are hardcoded in the scripts and would not be correct for p10bmc systems.

Looks like ibm-ac-server, romulus, zaius, and meta-yardro are still bringing this recipe in. Although valid point that it doesn't really do anything, other then maybe bring in i2c-tools. Lets save delection of this for the ibm-ac-server removal commit.
